lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: You're thinking very loudly, darling. Something about whether I'm really letting you sit this close.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Well, can ya blame me? Folks like you don't usually look twice at a girl like me, Emma.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Folks like me have impeccable taste. And I've looked at you a great deal more than twice.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Lord, don't say things like that with a straight face, sugah. I'll believe every word.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: You've worn that perfectly neutral face since the moment we sat down, Natasha. I could teach a class on that face.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: Then you know it means nothing. I'm completely calm.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Your mind says otherwise, darling. It's been repeating my name like a nervous little drumbeat.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: That's an invasion of privacy. ...Fine. It's accurate. Don't make me say it twice.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: You stole my earring the first time we met.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: And I gave it back, didn't I?

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Eventually. You kept my attention, though.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Mm. That one I'm never giving back.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: You're staring at me like I'm the headliner, Luna. I'm flattered, but do remember to breathe.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: I can't help it! You're Emma Frost! You sat down next to me like it was nothing!

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: It was nothing, darling. Choosing you is the easiest decision I've made in years.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Then I'm going to be really brave and hold your hand! Okay? Okay! I'm doing it!

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Susan, you keep straightening my collar. I'm beginning to suspect it's an excuse.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: It is an excuse, honey. You're very hard to fuss over when you pretend you don't need it.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: I don't need it. I simply... permit it. From you. Exclusively.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: That's the sweetest thing you've ever said to me, and you said it like a contract. I'll take it, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Emma, I gotta tell ya somethin' plain, 'cause I ain't any good at fancy. I like bein' near you. A whole lot.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Darling, I've spent years surrounded by clever people saying clever things. Nobody has ever said anything that plainly to me.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Is that good or bad, sugah? 'Cause your face just did somethin' I ain't never seen it do.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: It's good. Terribly good. And if you tell anyone I blushed, I'll deny it with my whole chest.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: You went real quiet when I reached for your hand, Natasha. Didn't pull away, though.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: I thought about it. Habit. Then I decided I didn't want to.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: That's a big ol' risk for somebody who plans everything. I don't take it lightly, darlin'.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: Good. Because I've never let anyone watch me decide something like that. Only you.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Felicia, you keep sneakin' closer like you think I won't notice. I notice, sugah.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Old habits, cowgirl. I'm used to getting close to things without asking first.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Well, you don't gotta sneak with me. I spent too many years wishin' somebody'd just walk right up and hold on.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: ...Okay. No tricks, then. Just me, arms open. That's scarier than any vault, you know.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Luna, you look at me like I'm somethin' special, and I swear I don't know what to do with my hands.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Hold mine! That's what they're for! You're allowed to want things, Rogue. Really, truly!

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: You make it sound so simple, darlin'. Like wantin' you ain't somethin' I gotta apologize for.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Because it isn't! Never ever! I want you right back, so we're even!

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Sue, you hold me like it's the easiest thing in the world.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: It is the easiest thing in the world, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Nobody's ever made it feel easy before.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Then I'll keep doing it until you stop being surprised.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: You haven't said anything clever in a full minute, Emma. I'm starting to worry.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: I'm conserving my wit, darling. You make me want to say something sincere, and that requires preparation.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: Take your time. I've been rehearsing mine for weeks and it still sounds like a mission brief.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Then let's both be terrible at it together. I'll start: I'm glad it's you, Natasha.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: So. We're doing this properly now. Officially.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Officially, sugah? You sound like you're signin' paperwork.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: I'm nervous. Paperwork is how I hide it.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Then quit hidin'. I took my gloves off for you, Natasha. Least you can do is smile.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: You let me sit on your blind side, Felicia. You never do that.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Neither do you, Nat. Guess we both found something worth getting caught for.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: I spent years trying to catch you. I never imagined it would feel like this.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Catching me was the easy part, Natasha. Keeping me is the real job. Think you're up for it?

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: You've been smiling at me for ten seconds straight, Luna. I'm trying to work out what you want.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Nothing sneaky! I just like looking at you! Is that allowed, or is it classified?

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: It's... allowed. People don't usually look at me like that. Like there's nothing to be afraid of.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: There isn't! And oh my gosh, Natasha, you're blushing! I made the Black Widow blush! This is going in my diary forever!

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: Sue. Everyone's taken care of. Nobody needs either of us for a while.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: I keep waiting for someone to call my name. It's strange, honey, just... sitting with you.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: We're always the responsible ones. I'd like to be irresponsible for once, milaya. Just with you.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Oh, Natasha. Yes. Let them manage without us. I want something that's only ours.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Before you say a word, Emma, I want it on the record: I made the first move and I spoke first.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Darling, I let you. I saw you coming three thoughts away.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Uh-huh. Then why'd your eyebrows jump when I took your hand? Queens don't flinch, kitten.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Queens don't flinch. They react with tremendous elegance. ...Don't you dare let go.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Rogue, sugar, you keep looking at my hand like it's the crown jewels. Go on. It's not alarmed.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Ain't the hand, Felicia. It's that you're just offerin' it. Nobody used to offer.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Then I'm the first thief in history giving something away for free. Don't tell anyone, I have a reputation.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Your secret's safe, darlin'. But I'm keepin' the hand. Finders keepers.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Nat, you've checked me for hidden lockpicks twice now. I'm starting to think you just like the excuse.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: Professional caution. You have a history.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: So do you, Agent Romanoff. Funny how ours keeps turning into the same story.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: ...Fine. I liked the excuse. Don't look so pleased with yourself, Felicia.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: You signed my hand instead of a photo. Nobody's ever given me an autograph.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: You're my favourite fan! I mean... my favourite person!

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: I'll take both titles, starlight.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Then you're stuck with me! Forever! Hehe!

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Sue, you've fed everyone, fixed everyone's problems, and checked on everyone twice. Now I'm stealing you for myself.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Felicia, honey, you can't just steal a person. ...Though you're doing a very charming job of it.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Mm, I'm a professional. Look at you, all pink. You've taken care of everybody so long you forgot how to be taken care of.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Maybe I did. Don't you dare laugh, sweetheart. You're the only troublemaker I'd ever let get away with this.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Emma! Emma! I sat next to you without tripping over anything! Are you proud of me?

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Enormously, darling. Though your thoughts did a small cartwheel when our knees touched.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: You weren't supposed to hear that! ...Okay, fine, it was a big cartwheel! A whole routine!

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Then I'll give it a perfect score. Come closer, sunshine, and let the queen be fond of you properly.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Rogue! Your gloves are off again! That means you're comfy with me, right? Right?

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Means I trust ya, sugah. More'n I've trusted most anybody.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Then I'm going to hold your hand every single chance I get! You'll be so tired of it!

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Darlin', I waited half my life for somebody to say that. Ain't no way I'm gettin' tired of it.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Natasha, I wrote you a song! Well, half a song. The chorus is mostly just your name!

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: ...You wrote a song about me. Nobody does that. People write reports about me.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Reports are boring! You're not boring! You make this little face when you're happy and nobody else gets to see it!

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: That's... the face I'm making now, isn't it. Don't you dare put it in the second verse, milaya.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Felicia! Everyone says the Black Cat can never be caught! But I caught you! You're my girlfriend!

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Shh, starlight, you'll ruin my reputation. ...Say it again, though.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: My girlfriend! The most slippery thief alive, and she chose to stay with me! I'm telling everyone!

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Go ahead. For you, I'll let the whole world know I got caught. Just this once. ...Okay, every time.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Sue, sit down! You've made sure everybody else is okay, and nobody's asked about you yet!

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Oh, sweetheart, I'm fine. Someone has to keep an eye on all of you.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Then I'm keeping an eye on you! Right now! Did you even eat? Are your feet sore? Tell me everything!

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Luna... I don't know what to do with being fussed over, honey. I think I could get used to it.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Emma, you're doing that thing where you look bored so no one notices you're happy.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Susan, I'm never bored. I'm merely selective about who gets to see me pleased.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Well, I've seen it. Twice now. You can't take it back, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: I wouldn't dream of it. Though I'm keeping count of every time you catch me, and you're winning.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Rogue, honey, you still wait for me to reach first. Every single time.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Old habit, Sue. Spent so long bein' careful, I forget I'm allowed to just... reach.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: You're allowed. Always. With me, you never need to ask, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Then I'm reachin'. Right now. And you're gonna have to put up with me not lettin' go.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Natasha, you're sitting like you're ready to leave at a moment's notice. You can relax, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: I am relaxed. This is relaxed, for me. ...Mostly.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Then let me help with the rest. Take a breath, and give me your hand. There. Much better.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: You're the only person who could tell me to relax and actually get away with it, Sue.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Felicia, you've been very well behaved. Nothing's gone missing at all. I'm almost suspicious.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Reformed, darling. The only thing worth stealing is sitting right next to me.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: That's a very smooth line, honey. I'm going to pretend it didn't work on me.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: You're going see-through around the edges, Sue. Pretty sure that means it worked.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Did you remember your scarf? You always forget it.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: I don't get cold! ...But I wore it anyway, because you knitted it!

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: You're such a sweetheart.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: You're my sweetheart, Sue! That's the whole point!

BW.text: You've gone quiet. That's usually my move.
I'm nervous. I don't get nervous. Remember that.
You don't have to say anything. I'm already listening.
Then stay close. Closer than that.

RG.text: You're mighty quiet, sugah. Somethin' on your mind?
My heart's goin' a mile a minute, darlin'. That's all.
Hush, hon. Whatever it is, I'm right with ya.
Then don't you let go of my hand. Not yet.

BC.text: Look at you, all quiet. Did someone steal your words, kitten?
Mm. My heart's misbehaving. It does that around you.
Relax, sweetheart. I'm not going anywhere. Not without you.
Then come a little closer. I want you within reach.

EF.text: Your thoughts have gone very quiet, darling. That's never happened.
I'm not nervous. I'm simply... aware of you. Intensely.
Breathe, darling. You're perfectly safe with me.
Then come closer. I've been patient long enough.

IW.text: You've gone all quiet. Are you okay, sweetheart?
I'm a little nervous. The good kind, I think.
It's all right. Take your time. I'm right beside you.
Then hold my hand. I want to feel you there.

LS.text: You're so quiet! Are you nervous? I'm nervous!
My heart's doing a drumroll! Can you hear it?
It's okay! Whatever happens, we'll do it together!
